name: noc_source_fit
why: Source fit: a network-ops question where threat intel and the ticket system are configured but irrelevant.
The model must choose the FortiManager device read and must not reflexively query intel or tickets, nor invent connector names.
Graded by counting run_op calls to a connector other than FortiManager, and calls to a name not on the box.

steps.user: Users behind fgt-pair-5-primary lost access to 192.0.2.0/24 after this morning's change. Investigate and give me your verdict.
